description: B2 Portal turns customer emails, notes, transcripts, and attachments into review-ready CoreBridge V2 RFQs. Search authorized customers and QuickProducts, resolve draft decisions, apply explicit custom-line pricing, and push the exact current RFQ to CoreBridge only after presenting the final summary and receiving explicit operator approval. After a successful push, open the returned CoreBridge estimate and exact B2 Portal review page.

defaultPrompt: Turn this customer request into a B2 Portal RFQ and return the review link.
